roles.title: Product Engineering Intern
points: Functionally tested a WhatsApp-driven e-commerce platform with an integrated AI agent, built for Moroccan merchants: designed test scenarios, identified and documented bugs before production release.
Audited advertising acquisition channels (Click-to-WhatsApp Ads, CPM benchmarks) and delivered a Meta Ads strategy report shaping the platform's customer acquisition approach.
Designed and presented a three-tier monetization model to the product team ahead of commercial launch.

roles.title: Web Developer Intern
points: Independently designed and developed a responsive showcase website in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript for a client company, handling the entire development cycle.
Integrated interactive JavaScript features: animations, navigation sidebar, contact form and map integration.
Deployed and maintained the site in production via Git and SFTP, with regular follow-up on client-requested changes.
Completed remotely during the school term, requiring independent management of priorities and deadlines.
